fieldNotes.facility: Large integrated kraft pulp/paper mill on the west bank of the St. Johns River, ~4 mi NE of downtown Palatka FL. Roster coordinate (29.650032, -81.647668) was in downtown Palatka, ~4 km off. Relocated via web research (215 County Road 216 / US-17 corridor, NE of Palatka) and satellite to the actual mill complex. Confirmed: kraft mill with woodyard, wood storage sheds, paper machines, rail yard, large distribution warehouse.
fieldNotes.truckGate: Mill is a fully fenced ~316-acre kraft mill complex; access road branches off US-17 with a railroad crossing into the property. A controlled, guarded truck entrance is standard for a paper mill of this scale (700+ employees, $400M tissue machine + $83M expansion). The gate structure is set behind a tree buffer and not directly resolvable in Street View — medium confidence.
fieldNotes.guardShack: Inferred present from facility scale and security profile; not positively imaged. Listed uncertain.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: Campus with multiple distinct building clusters: the kraft mill processing core, a large modern distribution warehouse to the south, woodyard storage sheds, and warehouse/converting buildings.
fieldNotes.dockDoors: Loading docks at the distribution warehouse (east face) and converting/warehouse buildings; ~30 doors estimated from overhead imagery — low confidence band 25-50.
fieldNotes.dropArea: Trailers parked in rows in the mill yard and near the warehouses; ~45 visible, banded 25-50.
fieldNotes.shipRcvSeparate: Inbound wood fiber received by rail and truck at the woodyard (north); finished-product shipping runs from the distribution warehouse docks (south) — physically separate clusters.
fieldNotes.scale: A truck scale is standard at a mill receiving wood fiber by truck; not positively imaged — listed uncertain.
fieldNotes.fastLaneOpportunity: The access road and yard have ample paved width; inferred room for a bypass lane — low confidence.
fieldNotes.railServed: Extensive multi-track rail yard runs through the complex alongside the woodyard.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Rural — mill is in forested/agricultural country NE of small-town Palatka, buffered by woods.
